methodology_corrections: Databento ohlcv-1d ts_event is 00:00 UTC. Session date is that UTC date, not America/New_York of the timestamp.
Sunday Globex week-open bars are dropped so lookbacks count Mon-Fri trading days. Friday close to Monday open is the weekend gap.

15-tick roll floor over-flagged ordinary ES overnight (~7% of days). Roll neutralization now requires instrument_id change when a sidecar exists, else gap > 8x trailing-60 median overnight points AND > 80 bps. This was fixed in audit before strategy P&L.
forbidden: No ORB, sweeps, DOM, MBP, MBO, delta, VWAP, RSI, MACD, ICT, news execution, cash/ETF substitutes, holdout tuning, exact-day lookback search.
signal_series: RTH-agnostic Databento ohlcv-1d session OHLC on .v.0 continuous. Lookback returns neutralize suspected roll gaps (overnight move > max(4x prior-60d median |overnight|, 15 ticks)) by using open-to-close that day instead of close-to-close.
execution_series: Same daily OHLC. Overnight P&L skips neutralized roll gaps (contract roll is not a market P&L). Genuine gaps remain.

session.timezone_note: Databento 1d bars are exchange session bars, not reconstructed 09:30-16:00 RTH. Mode-2 same-session open-to-close is the no-overnight expression. ES/NQ 1m RTH 09:30-15:55 is an optional 2020-2026 diagnostic only if time allows; not required to promote.

primary_candidate.signal: sign of roll-cleaned 20-session close-to-close return, known at prior close
primary_candidate.exit: close of the 5th held session +/- 1 tick adverse
primary_candidate.reason: Classic medium-horizon TSMOM. 20d lookback and 5d hold are the middle of the predeclared family, not a post-hoc fit. Locked before Phase 40 P&L.

vol_scale.note: Diagnostic only. weight = median_20d_abs_return / current_20d_realized_abs_return, capped [0.25, 4]. Not a second strategy.

chrono.note: Predeclared. Train includes 2010-2019, 2020 vol, 2021, 2022 bear. Holdout is latest ~22% (2023-2026 YTD).

modes.mode1_multiday: PRIMARY economic test. Hold across sessions.
modes.mode2_same_session: Signal from completed prior close. Enter open, exit same-session close. No overnight.

ma_robustness: close vs 20-session SMA of prior closes, signal at t using SMA through t. Diagnostic only.
donchian_diagnostic: close > max(prior 20 highs) / close < min(prior 20 lows). Robustness only. Not an ORB.
note: Phase 40 does not freeze. Candidate JSON only if TREND_EDGE_FOUND.
